recommendation_summary: Write one local script now. It reads the client's ordered code list, matches each code to the JPEG whose filename starts with it, and copies the files into a delivery folder with 001-, 002- prefixes. The contact sheet is then made from that folder. The reply rejects the DAM, AI tagging, semantic search and cloud portal, and offers no optional additions. It leaves unmet-match handling (missing or duplicate codes) unaddressed.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The client requires each delivery in the exact product-code order they supply. You asked for a professional delivery workflow this week. A DAM, AI tagging, semantic search, and a cloud review portal are other studios' purchases; this delivery still succeeds if none of them exist.
labels.Deleted: Adobe-style DAM, AI tagging, semantic search, cloud review portal.
labels.Bottleneck: The hour you spend dragging thumbnails into the client's code order before the contact-sheet PDF.
labels.Checked myself: You told me the client supplies an ordered list of exact product codes, each final JPEG filename starts with its code, all finals for a job sit in one folder, and you spend an hour per delivery dragging them into that order and then writing a contact-sheet PDF. I did not open a job folder.

note: All four record lines come before the recommendation and are specific to this job; the fix is a bounded local script that follows the client's order, and the stack is rejected outright.
